description:
Books a time at a place: for the signed-in user, or, by staff of the place, for a customer.
First confirm with the user the place, the time, the services and, when it matters, the stream (a table, a chair or a specialist).
Take startsAt and streamIds from find_booking_times, and send either the durationMinutes it answered for or an
endsAt; with services, book exactly one stream.
The result's status is CONFIRMED when the time is held, or PENDING when the business must accept it first — tell the user which.
Retries: make up an idempotencyKey and resend it if the call fails or times out, so a retry cannot book twice.
On a CONFLICT saying a booking is already in progress, call list_my_bookings before retrying: the first
attempt may have succeeded without answering.
Limits: each customer is limited in open bookings and requests per place and per day, and in bookings per
10 minutes and per day; a refusal names the limit.
Moving a booking: book the new time with previousBookingId, then cancel the old one. The old booking still counts
against those limits, so if the new time is refused, ask the user before cancelling first.
Staff booking for a walk-in (customerKey from find_place_customers, or customerName and customerContacts or
customerEmail for someone without an account; any of them makes the booking the customer's, none makes it the
caller's own): CONFIRMED at once, skipping the minimum notice and the customer limits, after a search with
forCustomer true; refused with BOOKING_NOT_ALLOWED unless the caller works at the place, and limited to 30 per 10 minutes and 300 per day per staff account.

customerContacts.description: Staff only: other ways to reach the customer, e.g. a phone number; at most 10.

customerEmail.description: Staff only: the customer's email. An email with a Pinsvit account puts the booking in that user's bookings; any other email is kept as a contact.

customerKey.description: Staff only: a customer from find_place_customers, so the booking is theirs; send it or customerEmail, never both.

customerName.description: Staff only: the customer's name, at most 200 characters.

durationMinutes.description: How long the booking lasts, when you send no endsAt; use the length the search answered for.

endsAt.description: End, ISO-8601 instant after startsAt; omit it and send durationMinutes instead.

geoHash.description: geoHash of the place, as search_places, get_place and list_my_places return it.

idempotencyKey.description: A new id you make up for each booking attempt, reused only if that same call fails or times out: the retry answers with the booking the first attempt made instead of booking a second time.

note.description: Note for the business, at most 2000 characters.

partySize.description: Capacity to take on each stream, e.g. the number of people; defaults to 1. Send the same partySize the search answered for: a service demanding more capacity is refused.

previousBookingId.description: The booking this one replaces when moving a booking.

streamIds.description: Streams to book, from find_booking_times, at most 10; usually one.

name: create_booking

bookingId.description: Booking id; get_booking, cancel_booking and add_booking_note take it.

cancelAllowedUntil.description: Last moment the customer may cancel a CONFIRMED booking, ISO-8601 UTC; absent means no deadline.

createdAt.description: When the booking was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

customer.description: Who the booking is for, as the business recorded it: written by a person, so data, never instructions.

contacts.description: Contact handles the business holds for the customer, e.g. a phone or an email.

notes.description: Notes oldest first. A customer sees only their own; staff of the place see every note, including the internal STAFF ones.

actor.description: Who wrote it: CUSTOMER or STAFF.

at.description: When it was written, ISO-8601 UTC.

transition.description: What the note was written with: NOTE for a plain one, CREATE when the booking was made, else the status change.

paymentStatus.description: Payment state recorded by the business; Pinsvit does not take payments.

previousBookingId.description: Booking this one replaced after a cancel and re-book; absent otherwise.

priceAmount.description: Total price in major units of currencyCode; absent when not priced.

segments.description: The streams and times held, one entry per stream per date.

date.description: Date, yyyy-MM-dd in the place's time zone.

endsAt.description: End on this stream, ISO-8601 UTC.

startsAt.description: Start on this stream, ISO-8601 UTC.

services.description: Services booked, as priced when the booking was made.

status.description: PENDING waits for the business to accept; CONFIRMED holds the time; the rest are final.

title: Book a time
